items.name: Orthonormal.inner_finsupp_eq_sum_left
items.type: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {ι : Type u_4} {v : ι → E} (hv : Orthonormal 𝕜 v) (l₁ l₂ : ι →₀ 𝕜) : inner 𝕜 ((Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 v) l₁) ((Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 v) l₂) = l₁.sum fun i y => (starRingEnd 𝕜) y * l₂ i

items.name: Orthonormal.inner_finsupp_eq_sum_right
items.type: {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜] [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] {ι : Type u_4} {v : ι → E} (hv : Orthonormal 𝕜 v) (l₁ l₂ : ι →₀ 𝕜) : inner 𝕜 ((Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 v) l₁) ((Finsupp.linearCombination 𝕜 v) l₂) = l₂.sum fun i y => (starRingEnd 𝕜) (l₁ i) * y

items.name: Polynomial.sum_sq_norm_coeff_eq_circleAverage
items.type: (p : Polynomial ℂ) : ∑ i ∈ p.support, ‖p.coeff i‖ ^ 2 = Real.circleAverage (fun θ => ‖Polynomial.eval θ p‖ ^ 2) 0 1

items.name: Polynomial.mahlerMeasure_le_sqrt_sum_sq_norm_coeff
items.type: (p : Polynomial ℂ) : p.mahlerMeasure ≤ √(∑ i ∈ p.support, ‖p.coeff i‖ ^ 2)
